## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal prediction isolates Benign at 90% coverage [F1], with unflagged tier-4 priority and 0% invasive risk.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 94%, InSitu 4%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Benign lead; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign (alpha = 0.10; 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 64th OOD percentile; 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; passes quality control |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Two independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 2/5 InSitu, 1/5 Normal [F5] | Mixed neighbors; InSitu cases nearby |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.30 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.32 contribution); weak concept, 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.30 contribution); 12/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.22 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 1, 10, 11) · context · 22% nuclei (100th reference percentile); insufficient tumor nuclei flagged [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier (3-region deletion drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197 excludes 0); region risks here are 0–0.001.
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); top drivers **normal lobules** and **frequent mitotic figures** are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- An in situ lesion is present, matching two of five nearest neighbors (contrast case BACH_0043, 91% similarity, InSitu).
- Region 3 contains stromal invasion (validated score 0.88) or unsampled regions hold atypia missed by HoVer-Net.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Confirm benign lobules and stroma; exclude nuclear pleomorphism driving the BACH_0043 InSitu contrast.
2. **Regions 2, 3**: Inspect ducts and stroma where validated invasion (score 0.88) and duct-confinement concepts localize.
3. **Regions 1, 10, 11**: Verify dense inflammation (22% nuclei) and dead cells (3% [F8]) with few neoplastic nuclei.
